claims.after_note: Evidence-scope review 2026-10-15-mcr43-conflicting-contexts: Earlier studies reported no independent resistance contribution in their tested contexts, including work using the historical mcr-4.2 name later corrected to mcr-4.3. A later clinical Acinetobacter study reported contrasting functional and lipid A results. These are context-dependent, conflicting findings, not universal activity or inactivity. They do not establish resistance to purified colistin A or B separately. Retain CARD's assertion as database evidence only; no experimental protein, organism or susceptibility observation is assigned. Qualification references, not an upgrade of the CARD assertion: DOI:10.1128/JCM.01562-17 (Functional interpretation in primary letter; publisher primary text; no figure or table visual verification). DOI:10.1128/AAC.00649-18 (Naming correction; Functional results and Figure 2 interpretation; publisher primary text; figures and supplements not visually verified). DOI:10.1093/jac/dkz413 (Results and discussion: functional and lipid A results; Conclusions; publisher primary HTML text accessed 2026-10-15; figures and supplements not reviewed).
